claim: Aurora MySQL parallel query is an optimization that parallelizes some of the I/O and computation involved in processing data-intensive queries.

values.display: parallelizes some of the I/O and computation

This data-intensive work is delegated (in database optimization terms, pushed down) to multiple nodes in the Aurora distributed storage layer.

performs all the query processing there
